messages:
leah: Quick sync — I need final acceptance criteria and rollback thresholds for the new versioned-traffic rollout. PRD is here: https://redwood.app/prd/versioned-traffic
matt: Looking now. Key question: do we treat quality regressions and infra errors the same for rollback?
pranav: I'd separate them. infra errors -> immediate rollback. quality regressions -> experiment pause + investigate. For infra, threshold = 0.5% 5xx across all tenants in 5m window.
olivia: For customer-facing regressions (token-level hallucination spike) we should have automated detection via eval hooks. If delta > 3% on failure tests -> pause.
leah: Draft acceptance criteria below, please sanity-check:
- Latency: p95 increase <= 25ms vs baseline during steady-state
- Errors: total 5xx <= 0.3% sustained across 1h window
- Quality: automated eval pass rate drop <= 2% on sentinel prompt set
- Cost: per-token cost delta <= +30% or must have sign-off
- Rollback trigger: any single-tenant error spike > 1% in 5m -> immediate rollback
matt: +1 on the rollback triggers. Add escalation path: pager to oncall, notification to account AE if tenant impacted.
olivia: Experiment plan proposal: ramp 1% -> 5% (24h) -> 25% (48h) -> 100% (72h) with automatic rollback on triggers. A/B: 50/50 quality cohort for the 25% stage.
pranav: Also require canary variant to run on dedicated infra slice to avoid noisy neighbor impact. If infra latency > 5% above baseline on canary slice -> stop ramp.
eng-bot: deploy scheduled: 2026-04-02T22:00Z. Will run canary for 2h then begin ramp if no infra alerts.
sre-ops: We'll enable extra tracing and token sampling in canary. Add log retention 7d for traces from rollout window.
leah: One more — acceptance sign-off matrix: PM (leah), Eng lead (matt), SRE oncall (sre-ops), Customer success (olivia) for tenant-impacting changes. Add legal if data-plane changes.
matt: I'll update the PRD and attach the final rollout JSON. Expect it by EOD.
leah: Thanks — will queue a 30m sync at 10:30 PT to greenlight.
